senses.gloss:
ध्यै ध्यै (probably akin to अधि-या, but cf. also दीधी, दीदी), i. 1, ध्याय (in epic poetry also ध्या, ii. 2, e. g. ध्याहि, MBh. 3, 13210), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 13, 1994).
 1. To contemplate, MBh. 2, 2563.
 2. To think of, 5, 47; to meditate on, 3, 224.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ध्यात, Thought of, Bhartṛ. 3, 46.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To meditate on, MBh. 1, 3464.
 2. To think of, 12, 9666 (with gen.).
 3. To reflect, Rām. 1, 2, 20 (अनुध्यात्वा, instead of ˚ध्याय). अनुध्यात,
 1. Thought of, MBh. 7, 2180.
 2. Absorbed in meditation, 12, 4678.
 --With समनु सम्-अनु-,
 1. To think of, MBh. 13, 968.
 2. To think, 12, 6644.
 --With अप अप, To disregard, MBh. 7, 2076.
 2. To hurt, 3, 13656.
 --With समप सम्-अप, To hurt, MBh. 3, 13655 (Ātm.).
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To desire, Yājñ. 3, 134.
 2. To think of, Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 44.
 3. To meditate, to be absorbed in meditation, Man. 1, 8.
 4. To curse (?), MBh. 13, 2144 (अभि-ध्यासुस्, 4. Aor. without augment in the sense of an imperat., cf. 2143).
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To reflect, MBh. 5, 2217.
 2. To desire, Suśr. 1, 323, 15.
 --With अव अव, To disregard, Bhāg. P. 5, 4, 9.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To wish that something may happen to another (gen.), MBh. 13, 4900.
 2. To be absorbed in meditation, Bhāg. P. 9, 14, 43.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To meditate [] on, Hariv. 14823.
 --With उप उप, To think of, MBh. 1, 3847; (Hariv. 7453, read अपध्यातो).
 --With नि नि, To be absorbed in meditation, Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 44.
 --With अभिनि अह्हि-नि, To attend to (acc.), Rām. 1, 28, 7.
 --With प्रणि प्र-नि, To direct one's attention to (acc.), Bhāg. P. 1, 7, 3.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To muse ver (acc.), Rājat. 1, 279.
 2. To reflect, Rām. 6, 31, 2.
 --With परि परि, To muse, Rām. 2, 37, 13 Gorr. (परी on account of the metre).
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To reflect, MBh. 1, 7013.
 2. To think of (acc. and प्रति), Hariv. 10381.
 3. To devise, MBh. 5, 3882.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To reflect, MBh. 3, 1411.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To devise, MBh. 5, 3880.
 --With सम् सम्, To reflect, MBh. 2, 8.
 --Cf. θεάω.
